activity.role: French military command in the Rif War
activity.notes: Pétain dispatched to Morocco in July 1925 and subsequently directed a key French operation against Abd el-Krim in the Rif; campaign ended with May 1926 capitulation. These are source-documented deployment/campaign-envelope approximate dates and NOT asserted exact appointment or relief from command; no independent Rif sovereign ruler classification. Activity domain emphasis: military.
